author: Inside Edition
description: Police officers jumped into action after a one-month-old baby stopped breathing. The NYPD released video of the response at a home in Queens. They say officers began chest compressions immediately to try to get the baby to breathe again. Officers wouldn't quit until they finally got what they wanted. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cops Perform CPR On Month-Old Baby Who Stopped Breathing

author: Inside Edition
description: Strong winds pushed an inflatable pumpkin from a North Carolina farm Sunday. An employee from the farm tried his best to stop it, but the pumpkin just rolled over him with no problem. The scene is reminiscent of an incident from last year when cops in Ohio had a hard time getting control of an inflatable pumpkin that got loose from a lawn and started rolling down the streets in Parma Heights.
title: Man Is No Match For Giant Runaway Inflatable Pumpkin

author: Inside Edition
description: What’s the most dangerous room in your home? It’s not the kitchen or your boiler room… It’s the bathroom! Studies show nearly 22 million people a year get injured in bathroom-related falls. Experts at the Arizona State University Locomotion Research Laboratory are now studying how to make bathrooms safer using slip and fall volunteers. And Jonathan Scott from Property Brothers has important tips on how to improve your bathroom to reduce falls.
title: What's The Most Dangerous Room In Your Home?

author: Inside Edition
description: Pope Leo has been diagnosed with lung cancer. The Vatican said the discovery was made after a recent surgery to remove a nodule from one of his lungs. Reports say the pontiff is recovering well from the surgery, but his health is on the minds of many Catholics. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Catholics Pray For Pope Leo After Cancer Diagnosis

author: Inside Edition
description: The two sisters had never met in real life, until a Montana softball tournament brought them together.
title: Reunited Softball Sisters Are Living A Real Life 'Parent Trap' #shorts
